API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingTenant Dc Exclusion Resource Update Data Center Exclusions
Tenant Dc Exclusion Resource Update Data Center Exclusions
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dcExclusions

Updates a Zscaler data center (DC) exclusion configuration based on the specified ID. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY ARRAY

The unique identifier for the DC exclusion configuration

Array [
dcid
int32

The unique identifier for the DC exclusion configuration

expired
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether the DC exclusion has expired

startTime
int32

The timestamp (in epoch) when the DC exclusion is set to begin and tunnels are disabled for the data center. The exclusion can be set to begin within a month from the current date and it must be at least 5 minutes from the current time (e.g., if the current time is 11:30 AM UTC, set the startTime to 11:35 AM UTC after converting it to Unix time.)

endTime
int32

The timestamp (in epoch) when the DC exclusion is set to expire and tunnels are re-enabled for the data center. The expiration can be set to happen within 15 days from the start time and it must be at least 2 hours from the start time (e.g., if the startTime Time is 11:30 AM UTC, set the endTime to 1:30 PM UTC after converting it to Unix time.)

description
string

Additional information about the DC exclusion

dcName
object
]
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
